purpose: The ONE definition of the Spry Labs entity (the shared authority piece, entity.json): the publisher Organization every published page of billionairehighperformancecoach.com, spryexecutiveos.com and aplayermode.com declares, the brand entity of each of those three sites, and the side businesses whose own entity.json points parentOrganization at Spry Labs. Read by scripts/lib/organization_node.cjs (JS: generators, scripts/repair/complete_organization_node.cjs, validate:organization-node, validate:entity-graph, the weekly scripts/entity/entity_backlink_watch.mjs) and by scripts/lib/citation_page_schema.py (Python: the citation program). It is one config file both languages read because both write this node; a constant in one is invisible to the other.
origin: 25 Oct 2026: all 3,480 Organization nodes on the site named Spry Labs and not one carried sameAs, because ten generators each wrote their own partial set. The JS repair completed them, and then repair_schema_parity.py - which runs later in container-prepush - rewrote 66 pages' publisher from its own hard-coded dict with name and logo only, dropping url and sameAs again. Two writers of one node is the defect; this file is the fix. 30 Oct 2026 (authority audit): the node grew an @id - /spry-labs is the Spry Labs entity home every side business points parentOrganization at - and lost two sameAs: spryexecutiveos.com is one of this repo's own hosts (self-reference), and the founder's personal site carries a Person whose worksFor is a West Peek company, which tied Spry Labs to West Peek in the knowledge graph against the Spry/West Peek separation rule.
truth_boundary: sameAs holds ONLY profiles that really exist and resolve now (data/entities/authority_signal_manifest.json: 'Only actually-known ... sameAs ... signals are claimed'). Never this repo's own hosts, never the founder's personal site, never anything naming West Peek (forbidden_same_as_hosts). A profile named but not yet live goes in profiles_pending and enters sameAs only when the weekly watch sees it resolve - and, where the platform renders server-side, link back. A pending entry with url null has no address yet; nobody guesses one, because a guessed LinkedIn or Crunchbase slug can belong to another company.
